{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:")
print(df.dtypes)
print("\nMissing values:")
print(df.isnull().sum())
print("\nUnique patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Number of duplicate patient_ids:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())
print("\nSample_seq distribution:")
print(df['sample_seq'].value_counts().sort_index())
print("\nBaseline biomarker -999 count:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())
print("\nArm distribution:")
print(df['arm'].value_counts())
print("\nSeverity distribution:")
print(df['severity'].value_counts())
print("\nSex distribution:")
print(df['sex'].value_counts())
print("\nAssay batch distribution:")
print(df['assay_batch'].value_counts())

# Check if there are any rows with -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("\nRows with -999 in biomarker_baseline:")
print(df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].head())"}
